proof_summary: At \(n=9\), the primorial is \(223092870\), and direct computation gives \(223092870^2+1=29^2\cdot 59180057841661=29^2\cdot53\cdot1116604864937\). Since the prime \(29\) occurs with multiplicity at least two, this term is not squarefree, so the universal squarefreeness claim—and hence the conjunction—fails.
